name: opencode-proxy-health
description: VS Code status-bar monitor for the OpenCode SSH SOCKS5 + HTTP bridge + Zen/Muse Spark chain, with one-click recovery runbook and opt-in self-healing.

commands.title: OpenCode Proxy: Turn Proxy Off Safely
OpenCode Proxy: Copy Diagnostics to Clipboard
OpenCode Proxy: Restart SSH Tunnel Task
OpenCode Proxy: Restart HTTP Bridge Task
OpenCode Proxy: Recover Proxy (direct supervisor, state machine)
OpenCode Proxy: Disable Legacy Task Scheduler Tasks (end supervisor conflict)
OpenCode Proxy: Check Network / Repair SG Now (manual)

opencodeProxyHealth.httpPort.description: Local HTTP-to-SOCKS bridge port to probe.

opencodeProxyHealth.zenEndpoint.description: Zen model-list endpoint checked through the HTTP proxy.

opencodeProxyHealth.model.description: Model id that must be present in the Zen model list.

opencodeProxyHealth.expectedExternalIp.description: Expected egress IP seen through the proxy — the AWS Elastic IP (empty string to skip the comparison).

opencodeProxyHealth.checkTimeoutMs.description: Legacy overall timeout floor (process checks, SG repair). Fast-path budgets below take precedence for polling.

opencodeProxyHealth.portProbeTimeoutMs.description: LEVEL 1 budget per local port probe (:1080/:8080, ms). Loopback is fast; keep <=1000.

opencodeProxyHealth.transportProbeTimeou.description: LEVEL 2 budget for the lightweight HTTPS transport probe through :8080 (ms). Never an echo service, never Zen.

opencodeProxyHealth.transportProbeUrl.description: LEVEL 2 target: lightweight stable HTTPS URL (2xx/3xx = transport OK). Must not be an IP-echo service or Zen.

opencodeProxyHealth.zenProbeTimeoutMs.description: LEVEL 3 budget for the Zen service probe (ms). Separate slow cadence, display-only.

opencodeProxyHealth.zenProbeIntervalSec.description: Seconds between Zen service probes. Zen never gates proxy health.

opencodeProxyHealth.failureThreshold.description: Consecutive failed probes before PROXY_DOWN is confirmed (earlier strikes show DEGRADED only, no notify, no recovery).

opencodeProxyHealth.minOutageNotifySec.description: Confirmed outage length that matters: shorter blips recover silently without a 'down for Xs' notification.

opencodeProxyHealth.recentTrafficWindowS.description: Seconds a tracked OpenCode success vetoes a transport-only probe failure (strongest signal wins).

opencodeProxyHealth.notifications.description: Pop-up notifications: all (failures + recoveries + request failures), errors (failures only), or none.

opencodeProxyHealth.slowThresholdMs.description: Healthy checks slower than this show a SLOW warning (0 disables).

opencodeProxyHealth.logToFile.description: Persist transition log to the extension's storage (proxy-health.log) for post-mortems.

opencodeProxyHealth.logFileMaxLines.description: Maximum lines kept in the persisted log file.

opencodeProxyHealth.trackRequests.description: Watch the request lockfile directory (opt-in tracking via scripts/Invoke-TrackedOpencode.ps1).

opencodeProxyHealth.autoRecover.description: Opt-in self-healing for local SOCKS and HTTP bridge failures. Starts existing scheduled tasks and, when enabled, resets a stuck task whose port is confirmed closed. Off = monitoring only.

opencodeProxyHealth.autoRecoverMaxAttemp.description: Max automatic start attempts per outage, per task.

opencodeProxyHealth.sshTaskName.description: Scheduled-task name started for SSH_DOWN recovery.

opencodeProxyHealth.bridgeTaskName.description: Scheduled-task name started for HTTP_BRIDGE_DOWN recovery.

opencodeProxyHealth.statusStyle.description: Status-bar item: icon-only tool glyph (details in tooltip/dashboard), or the full text.

opencodeProxyHealth.autoRecoverDryRun.description: With autoRecover on: log what self-healing would do without starting anything (safe testing).

opencodeProxyHealth.compactTooltip.description: Show a short tooltip (state + last check) instead of the full breakdown.

opencodeProxyHealth.runbookPortWaitSec.description: How long a one-click recovery step waits for its port to open before declaring failure.

opencodeProxyHealth.runbookLaunchOpencod.description: After a one-click recovery verifies the chain, launch opencode in a new terminal with the proxy env applied without asking. Off = always ask first.

opencodeProxyHealth.opencodeCommand.description: Command typed into the new terminal when the runbook launches opencode (step 7).

opencodeProxyHealth.autoRecoverResetStuc.description: When autoRecover is on, allow it to stop and restart a scheduled task marked Running whose port remains closed. Turn off to permit starts only. A working port is never stopped.

opencodeProxyHealth.supervisorMode.description: direct (recommended): the extension spawns and owns exactly one ssh.exe + one hpts (single-owner, verified ports + SOCKS end-to-end + AWS SG repair). task (legacy): use existing Windows Task Scheduler tasks only. Do NOT enable both supervisors at once — disable the scheduled tasks when supervisorMode is direct.

opencodeProxyHealth.ec2Host.description: AWS EC2 SSH endpoint probed directly (TCP 22, proxy bypassed) — the static Elastic IP, never the laptop's public IP.

opencodeProxyHealth.sshExe.description: Full path to Windows OpenSSH ssh.exe owned by the direct supervisor.

opencodeProxyHealth.sshKeyPath.description: Private-key path for the direct ssh tunnel (%VAR% expanded). Never logged.

opencodeProxyHealth.hptsCmd.description: Full path to the hpts bridge launcher owned by the direct supervisor.

opencodeProxyHealth.securityGroupId.description: EC2 security group id guarding SSH (e.g. sg-0abc...). Empty disables AWS SG auto-repair. Repair uses the existing AWS CLI profile — never hardcode credentials in settings.

opencodeProxyHealth.awsProfile.description: AWS CLI profile for SG repair (empty = default profile chain). No secrets here.

opencodeProxyHealth.awsRegion.description: AWS region for SG repair (the Elastic IP 16.192.228.28 lives in eu-north-1; empty = CLI default/env fallback).

opencodeProxyHealth.enableAwsRepair.description: Allow the direct supervisor to replace stale proxy /32 SSH rules with the current public IP (least-privilege, verified, never 0.0.0.0/0). Requires securityGroupId + AWS CLI.

opencodeProxyHealth.bootstrapRecoverOnSt.description: On VS Code startup: health-check first; if unhealthy, run the direct state-machine recovery once (bounded, idempotent). Works before OpenCode is usable and never requires OpenCode.

opencodeProxyHealth.publicIpPollSec.description: Seconds between direct public-IP polls (proxy bypassed; minimum effective interval 30s). 0 disables polling. For automatic Wi-Fi recovery set 30, autoRecover=true, supervisorMode=direct, and configure securityGroupId + local AWS CLI access. Proxy Off pauses all checks and repair.

opencodeProxyHealth.recoveryMaxAttempts.description: Bounded attempts per stage in the direct recovery state machine.

opencodeProxyHealth.recoveryBaseDelayMs.description: Base exponential-backoff delay (ms) between direct recovery retries (capped internally).

opencodeProxyHealth.socksWaitSec.description: How long the direct supervisor waits for :1080 after spawning ssh.

opencodeProxyHealth.httpWaitSec.description: How long the direct supervisor waits for :8080 after spawning hpts.
